Name: (CR) World Map Recolors for Kisaa's Maps
Author: crystalinerose
Description:
[center][size=4]A recolor compatibility patch I made for various maps I've made over the years, made to match Earthy, VPR, and Starblue world recolors, all in one download.[/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=4]🍊 Currently supported maps! 🍊[/size][/center]
[center][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27986]Cliffside Cove[/url] | [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28213]Secret Grove[/url] | [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28593]Blossom Crest[/url] | [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29248]Azure Springs[/url] | [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29455]Wildflower Acres[/url][/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[i][img]https://i.ibb.co.com/Lx0ybss/config-options.png[/img][/i]

[list]
[*][b]Manual Recolor Selection: [/b]Toggle for which world recolor mod the compatibility patch will be applied to. Default [i]Off. [/i]May require a restart if this setting is changed mid-game.[/*]
[*][b]Vibrant Pastoral Fall Variant: [/b]Toggle compatibility for Orange or Green fall in VPR. Default [i]Green.[/i][/*]
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/3NC8PLn/compatibility.png[/img]

[b][u]Compatible[/u] [/b]with the following world recolor mods: [b]Earthy Recolor, Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn, Starblue Valley.[/b]

[u][b]No compatibility with other world recolor mods will be provided from my end.[/b][/u] If you'd like to do so, please contact me first and arrangements can be discussed!

﻿[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/0sYpYjq/installation.png[/img]

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.[/*]
[*]Install any of my farm maps listed at the top of the page.﻿[/*]
[*]Download and unzip [i]"[CR] World Map Recolors for Kisaa's Maps" [/i]archive into your SteamLibrary/common/Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/*]
[*]﻿Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Configure the [b]Manual Recolor Selection [/b]setting before starting your save.[/*]
[*]The recolor patches will be applied accordingly. Enjoy![/*]
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/JRHCTRD/bugs-issues.png[/img]

[list]
[*]No known issues for the time being.[/*]
[/list][size=3][b]Please prioritize reporting any bugs on the Nexus page and follow the directions listed in the pinned comment.[/b][/size]

[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/VVn4qL0/credits.png[/img]

Thank you to the mod authors server for encouraging me to pick up modding again, even for a relatively simple mod, and for being trusty rubber ducks as usual :))

A special thank you to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Teaiscoldagain?gameId=1303]Lina[/url] and her recolor tool, without which I would have cried doing all these assets. If you are a pixel artist who wants to recolor your stuff 10x faster and are interested to test/give feedback for the recolor tool, feel free to reach out to Lina (@teaiscoldagain) on Discord or in the [url=https://discord.gg/stardewvalley]Stardew Valley official server[/url]!

[center][size=3]🍊 Enjoy my works? You can follow me on [url=http://meadowlade.tumblr.com]my Tumblr[/url]﻿, or support me by buying a [url=https://ko-fi.com/crystalinerose]coffee[/url]﻿! :) 🍊[/size][/center]
[center]🍊 Press the Track button on my Nexus profile if you want to be notified for my future mod releases! 🍊 [/center]
